Download an SRC (School Report Card) report

txs_get_src.Rd

TEA publishes the School Report Card as per-campus (or district) reports, not as bulk data files. This function downloads one report through TEA's public SAS-broker interface and, where TEA serves an HTML report, parses it into a tidy masking-aware tibble.

Usage

txs_get_src(
  year,
  level = c("campus", "district"),
  geography = NULL,
  format = c("auto", "html", "pdf"),
  cache = TRUE,
  refresh = FALSE,
  output = c("tidy", "raw"),
  timeout = 60,
  verbose = TRUE
)

Arguments

year

Integer ending year (e.g. 2024 for 2023-24).

level

"campus" or "district".

geography

A single campus (9-digit) or district (6-digit) number, quoted to preserve leading zeros.

format

"auto" (HTML when TEA offers it, else PDF), "html", or "pdf".

cache

If TRUE, reuse a cached copy when one exists.

refresh

If TRUE, re-download even if cached.

output

For HTML reports: "tidy" (long, masking-aware) or "raw" (the report's text lines, one row per line).

timeout

HTTP timeout in seconds.

verbose

Print progress messages.

Value

For HTML reports, a tibble with columns year, school_year, level, geography, school_name, district_name, page, section, measure, row_label, column, value, value_num, masked, mask_code. For PDF reports, a one-row tibble with the cached file's path and provenance. Both carry a txschools attribute.

Coverage

  • 2004-2012 campus reports are available as HTML and are parsed into a tidy long tibble.

  • 2004-2012 district reports and all 2013-2019 reports are published by TEA as PDF only. These are downloaded to the cache and returned as a one-row tibble describing the file (see Value).

  • 2020 and later SRC reports live at https://txschools.gov, which this package does not scrape.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
src_2011 <- txs_get_src(2011, "campus", "161920102")
} # }
